chunks: “Gifts are of three types: a gift given in reciprocation, a gift given to seek favor, and a gift given for Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.الْهَدِيَّةُ: a gift or present that is given to another
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; an expression of Allah’s exaltation
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for the sake of Allah alone, with sincere intention
key_terms.مُصَانَعَةٍ: seeking favor, goodwill, or managing relations through a gift
key_terms.مُكَافَأَةٍ: reciprocation or giving in return for something

ai.seo_question: What are the types of gifts according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام classifies gifts into three kinds based on intention and purpose. The hadith highlights that giving may be motivated by reciprocity, worldly relationship-building, or sincerity for the sake of Allah عز وجل, with the last indicating the highest spiritual motive.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4077 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Gifts are of three types: a gift given in reciprocation, a gift given to seek favor, and a gift given for the sake of Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious."
